methods.label: Remove the common multiples
methods.explanation: There are 10 multiples of 2. Among them, those that are also multiples of 3 (that is, multiples of 6) are 6, 12, and 18, giving 3 numbers. Therefore, 7 numbers satisfy the condition, and the probability is \(7/20\).
